title: ReMova: Fine-tuning LLMs for English to Belarusian translation
abstract: arXiv:2609.16427v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a Belarusian-specific data-cleaning pipeline and fine-tuning for English-Belarusian machine translation. Our cleaning pipeline distinguishes itself from others by employing a correction tool that addresses the issue of the two orthographies of the Belarusian language, noise in the training data, interference from other languages and other misspelling issues common in Belarusian on the internet. A matched ablation on unfiltered training data shows substantial benefits from filtering for all fine-tuned models, with the LLM-based models gaining roughly twice as much from filtering as the dedicated encoder-decoder MT system, supporting the view that for Belarusian MT one of the primary bottlenecks is data quality.

translated_title: ReMova：针对英语到白俄罗斯语翻译的大语言模型微调
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种专门针对白俄罗斯语的数据清洗流程，以及用于英语-白俄罗斯语机器翻译的模型微调方法。我们的清洗流程与其他流程的不同之处在于，它采用了一种纠错工具，用以解决白俄罗斯语存在两种正字法的问题、训练数据中的噪声、其他语言的干扰以及互联网上白俄罗斯语常见的其他拼写错误问题。在未过滤训练数据上进行的匹配消融实验表明，数据过滤对所有微调模型都有显著益处，其中基于大语言模型的模型从过滤中获得的收益大约是专用编码器-解码器机器翻译系统的两倍，这支持了这样一种观点：对于白俄罗斯语机器翻译而言，主要瓶颈之一是数据质量。
tldr: 本文提出了针对白俄罗斯语的专用数据清洗流程和英语-白俄罗斯语翻译的大语言模型微调方法，实验表明数据过滤显著提升翻译质量，且大语言模型从过滤中的获益约为传统编码器-解码器系统的两倍，证实数据质量是白俄罗斯语机器翻译的主要瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a Belarusian-specific data-cleaning pipeline and LLM fine-tuning for English-Belarusian machine translation, showing that data filtering substantially improves translation quality—with LLM-based models gaining roughly twice as much as encoder-decoder systems—confirming that data quality is a primary bottleneck for Belarusian MT.
